FAQ.title: We answer your questions
FAQ.subtitle: {count} questions organized by topic. Users, credit lines, Club, Elder Care, and Merchants.

users.a1: SaludTech is a medical financing platform with no interest (BNPL — Buy Now, Pay Later). It lets you pay for health services —pharmacies, clinics, specialists, telemedicine, and Elder Care— paying only an initial amount and the rest in installments every 14 days, with 0% interest.
users.a2: Any Venezuelan person over 18 years old with a valid ID card and an active phone number. You don't need a prior credit history or a bank account.
users.a3: Pre-approval takes less than 3 minutes from the website. You only need your ID, phone number, and basic info. No paperwork, no office visits, no waiting.
users.q4: Are there interest or hidden charges?
users.a4: No. SaludTech always charges 0% interest. The only possible additional charge is the reactivation fee ($4) if an installment is overdue and you need to reactivate your account. There's no membership fee or opening charges.
users.q5: How does payment at the merchant work?
users.a5: The merchant generates a QR code from their portal. You scan it with the SaludTech website, see the breakdown (initial + installments), confirm with your biometric PIN, and that's it. The entire transaction takes less than 30 seconds.
users.q6: What happens if I don't pay an installment on time?
users.a6: Your line is temporarily paused until you regularize the payment. A reactivation fee of $4 is applied. You may also lose accumulated Club SaludTech points. Enabling reminders on the website prevents this.
users.q7: Can I use SaludTech to pay online?
users.a7: Yes. In addition to physical merchants with QR, you can pay for telemedicine services and online pharmacies directly from the website, without scanning any code.
users.q8: What currency does SaludTech operate in?
users.a8: SaludTech operates in US dollars (USD). Amounts are also shown in bolívares at the BCV rate of the day for your reference, but charges are made in USD.
users.q9: How do I pay my installments?
users.a9: From the website you can pay with interbank mobile payment, bank transfer, or cash in dollars at authorized locations. You'll receive automatic reminders 3 days before each due date.

creditLines.q1: How many credit lines are there?
creditLines.a1: SaludTech offers three lines: Everyday Health (everyday medications and consultations, up to $80), Main Specialty (specialized procedures, up to $250+), and Greater Care (Elder Care home services, monthly subscription).
creditLines.q2: How is my initial credit limit calculated?
creditLines.a2: When you sign up, your profile is evaluated (identity data, phone, declared history). All users start at Level 1 with a ~$80 line. The limit grows automatically as you level up.
creditLines.q3: Can I use several lines at the same time?
creditLines.a3: Yes. You can have active transactions in Everyday Health and Main Specialty simultaneously, as long as you have available balance in each line.
creditLines.q4: How many installments does each line have?
creditLines.a4: Everyday Health: 1 initial + 1 installment (Level 1-2) or 3 installments (Level 3+). Main Specialty: 3 installments (Level 1-2), up to 12 installments (Level 6). Greater Care: automatic monthly debit.
creditLines.q5: What happens when I pay an installment? Do I recover available balance?
creditLines.a5: Yes. Each installment you pay frees up that amount in your available line, just like a revolving credit card. This lets you make new purchases without waiting for the plan to close.
creditLines.q6: What services does Everyday Health cover?
creditLines.a6: Medications at pharmacies and drugstores, general medicine consultations, routine exams (blood count, glucose, lipid panel), and health products at specialized stores.
creditLines.q7: Does the Main Specialty line cover hospitalization?
creditLines.a7: Yes, as long as the partner merchant is the clinic or medical center providing the service. Coverage includes elective hospitalization, scheduled surgeries, advanced imaging, and specialized consultations.

club.a1: It's SaludTech's loyalty program. You accumulate points for each on-time payment, and as you level up you access a higher credit limit, lower initial percentage, more available installments, and exclusive benefits.
club.a2: You earn points in several ways: on-time payment (+10 pts per installment), early payment (+15 pts, more than 10% bonus), referring a friend who signs up (+40 pts), and active monthly usage (+5 pts).
club.a3: There are 6 levels: Level 1 Bronze, Level 2 Silver, Level 3 Gold, Level 4 Platinum, Level 5 Diamond, and Level 6 Elite. Each level unlocks better financing terms.
club.q4: What changes when I level up?
club.a4: When you level up, your credit limit increases, the initial payment percentage decreases (from 50% at Level 1 to 25% at Level 6), and you access more installments. From Level 3 you can finance in 6, 9, or 12 installments. Level 4+ unlocks Elder Care.
club.a5: Your level doesn't drop automatically, but points not paid for overdue installments are deducted. If your point balance falls below the minimum threshold for your current level, you could be demoted. Paying on time maintains and raises your level.
club.q6: How do I refer a friend?
club.a6: From the 'Referrals' section on the website you get your unique code or link. When your friend signs up and makes their first purchase, both of you automatically receive the referral points.
club.q7: Do points have an expiration date?
club.a7: Points don't expire as long as your account is active and you've made at least one transaction in the last 6 months. Accounts inactive for more than 6 months may lose accumulated points.

elderCare.q1: What is the Greater Care line?
elderCare.a1: It's a monthly subscription to hire home health services for elderly adults. It includes a nurse, professional caregiver, physiotherapy, and geriatric specialist visits. Charges are automatically debited each month from your Greater Care line.
elderCare.q2: From what level is Elder Care available?
elderCare.a2: The Greater Care line is unlocked starting at Level 4 (Platinum). This ensures the user has a responsible payment history before accessing recurring subscription services.
elderCare.q3: Who can receive Elder Care services?
elderCare.a3: The account holder can hire services for any elderly adult under their care: parents, grandparents, in-laws, or other direct relatives. The beneficiary doesn't need to be a SaludTech user.
elderCare.q4: How much does the subscription cost?
elderCare.a4: The cost varies by plan and level: from $100/month (Level 4) to $150/month (Level 6 Elite). The plan is automatically deducted from your Greater Care line on the renewal date.
elderCare.q5: Can I choose the days and times of the service?
elderCare.a5: Yes. When activating the subscription, you select the days, times, and type of service from the website. You can modify the schedule with at least 24 hours' notice at no additional cost.
elderCare.q6: Can I cancel the Elder Care subscription?
elderCare.a6: Yes, without penalty and at any time from the website. Services scheduled within the already-paid period are completed normally. The following month's debit is not charged.
elderCare.a7: Yes. All professionals in SaludTech's Elder Care network have identity verification, background checks, and first aid certification. Nurses have a registered university degree.
elderCare.q8: What happens if the caregiver can't attend?
elderCare.a8: SaludTech guarantees replacement in less than 2 hours or rescheduling at no cost. If coverage fails, that day is credited to your next bill.

merchants.q1: Who can sign up as a merchant?
merchants.a1: Any health sector business in Venezuela with a tax ID (RIF) and the ability to issue fiscal invoices: pharmacies, clinics, medical offices, laboratories, imaging centers, physiotherapy, dentistry, optical stores, and Elder Care services.
merchants.a2: Typical activation is 48 hours for individual offices and up to 5 business days for clinics with multiple branches. The process is 100% digital, no office visits.
merchants.q3: What documents do I need to sign up?
merchants.a3: Commercial registry (or constitutive document), latest valid board meeting minutes, updated RIF in PDF, valid ID of the legal representative, and a fiscal invoice issued by the business.
merchants.q4: How do I generate a QR charge?
merchants.a4: From your merchant web portal, you enter the amount and service description. The system generates a unique QR valid for 5 minutes. The patient scans it and confirms. You receive real-time payment confirmation.
merchants.q5: When and how do I get paid?
merchants.a5: SaludTech settles your account in the agreed cycle (weekly or biweekly) for the accumulated amount of your transactions, minus the MDR. Settlement is made by bank transfer or mobile payment to your registered account.
merchants.q6: What is the MDR and how much is it?
merchants.a6: The MDR (Merchant Discount Rate) is the commission the merchant pays SaludTech for the financing service. The standard MDR is 3.5% per transaction. This cost is not passed on to the patient. High-volume merchants can access preferential rates.
merchants.q7: Do I assume any risk if the patient doesn't pay their installments?
merchants.a7: No. SaludTech assumes 100% of the patient's credit risk. Once the transaction is confirmed (the patient pays the initial amount and SaludTech validates), your payment is guaranteed regardless of whether the patient pays their installments.
merchants.q8: Do I need to install any hardware or POS?
merchants.a8: No. You only need internet access and a device to display the QR (tablet, computer, or print the code). There are no physical terminals, no installations, no hardware costs.
merchants.a9: Yes. You can manage multiple branches from a single merchant portal. Each branch has its own account and transaction report, but settlement can be consolidated into a single bank account.
